title: pvPlotOnSortedLines
body:
## pvPlotOnSortedLines

Takes polydata made of line segments, for example the lines produced by slicing a surface, and reassembles them into continuous, ordered polylines, adding an arc_length point array measured along each one. The output is a multiblock dataset with one block per continuous segment, suitable for line charts of a field against distance along an intersection curve. Use pvPlotOnIntersectionCurves to slice and sort in one step, or probeLine / pvPlotOverLine to sample along a straight line instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Branching curves are split at junctions into separate blocks; plot each block, not the whole output, as one series.
- Input must be polydata with line cells; slice or extract edges first.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PlotOnSortedLines`. Identity: `filters/PlotOnSortedLines`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
